facts.claim: 2014년 9월 22일 뉴욕 기후 주간 · Climate Group + CDP
facts.note: (검색 요약) RE100 was launched at Climate Week NYC on September 22, 2014. Climate Group is responsible for day-to-day governance, while CDP acts as RE100's technical and disclosure partner.
(검색 요약) RE100 companies must set targets that see them reach 60% renewable electricity by 2030, 90% by 2040 and 100% by 2050 at the latest.
(검색 요약) The campaign began with 13 companies representing 19 TWh of demand. By mid-2017 it had 100 members
